scope: Runtime arm/hand additive animation and source-mesh keypose inspection. Not Unity playback.

runtime.modifiedChannels: Upperarm and Hand rotations only; no bone position/scale edits; no Body/Torso/leg edits.

reload.mechanicalLatch: single smoothed pulse, no rapid oscillation

runtime.idle: One small wrist inspection after 3.5 seconds quiet standing; cancelled by movement/fire/reload/wall.

aimAlignment.reload: suppressed at peak gesture, returns during final 28%

validation.CharacterAnimationTests: PASS 9387 assertions; full production component and envelope math against narrow Unity stand-ins, 30/60/120 FPS, no transform accumulation, restore ownership, reload complete/parallel aims, self/floor wall filtering.
validation.AnimationGroundingIntegrationTests: Independent review initially passed 5013 assertions combining actual GroundFeedback restoration and character component. Final consolidated suite is recorded by root integration.

limitations: Reload is a stylized wrist/arm reset; current pistols have no removable magazine or slide animation.
Wall gesture intentionally does not fold active firing arms.
Blender keyposes are visual/geometry evidence, not real Unity skinning/PhysX or final in-game animation quality.
Source Blender and FBX animation Actions were not modified.
